note: Penn South and Chelsea residents: stoops, domino tables, co-op meetings.

lines.text: Buenas! Carmen's boy! Look at you!
Hot one. Sit, sit, have a soda.
Union built these towers. Ten of 'em. Ours.
Dominoes at six. Bring your losing face.
My sister's building on Twenty-Ninth got sold. Everybody's buying.
Co-op meeting ran three hours. Over a dog.
Rain! Bring the chairs in! The domino table too!
Hydrant's open on Twenty-Seventh. Kids are happy.
Lights out. Get the candles. Get the radio.
Late! Go to bed, you'll scare your mother.
